items.text: The first year of work brings an expectations gap, unclear feedback, a steep learning curve, money pressure and difficult bosses, and most of these improve when you ask specific questions, write down what you learn and build a few trusted relationships.
Expect a gap between college and work, ask for feedback early, keep a learning log and protect your health and money.
Read them before you sign and ask HR about anything unclear.
